articles.summary: A man inherited 400 square yards of leasehold land from his late mother in 1997. Towards the end of 1999, he entered into an agreement with a developer to demolish the existing house and construct a new building.

articles.title: India remains top Russian crude buyer in September despite 29% fall in imports since July
articles.summary: India has remained the largest destination for Russian crude oil, although imports decreased significantly from peak levels. In September, India imported around 1.82 million barrels per day, while competition from China intensified.

articles.title: India's WPI inflation surges to 11.39% in September on higher food, fuel prices
articles.summary: India's wholesale price index-based inflation surged to 11.39% in September due to higher food, manufactured items, and energy prices. Wholesale inflation has risen significantly amidst global commodity inflation linked to the ongoing West Asia conflict.

articles.title: US inflation accelerates to 3.7% in September as gasoline prices surge
articles.summary: September's inflation report shows a notable rise in US consumer prices, hitting 3.7%. This surge can be traced back to escalating gasoline costs and strong core inflation signals.

articles.title: Kumar Mangalam Birla plans up to $30 billion investment despite global uncertainties
articles.summary: The Aditya Birla Group plans to deploy capital across its businesses in India and overseas over the next two to three years, while taking a more gradual approach to artificial intelligence investments.

articles.title: What does RBI's new Consolidated Account Statement measure benefit you? Explained
articles.summary: RBI’s new CAS move: Announced on October 7, 2026, the measures will allow SEBI-regulated depositories to include information related to deposit accounts in CAS. RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said the measures would be implemented by December 31, 2026.

articles.summary: The IDBI Bank stake sale to Fairfax Financial’s parent entity marks a major shift in the lender’s ownership, with the government and LIC set to divest a combined 60.72% stake.

articles.title: Centre approves Fairfax Financial’s ₹52,878 crore bid for 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank
articles.summary: The transaction involves the sale of a 30.48% stake held by the Government of India and a 30.24% stake held by Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC). Following the transaction, the government will retain a 15% stake in the bank, while LIC will continue to hold 19%.

articles.title: Diwali bonanza for railway staff: 78-day bonus cleared for 11.4 lakh employees
articles.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved a Productivity Linked Bonus for railway employees worth Rs 2,009.61 crore. It will benefit approximately 11.41 lakh eligible railway staff members across various categories. The maximum bonus that each eligible employee can receive is Rs 17,951.

articles.title: India’s treasury bill yields hit four-year high premium over repo rate amid rate hike bets
articles.summary: India’s short-term government borrowing costs have surged to their highest levels in 18 months, with treasury bill yields widening their premium over the repo rate to a four-year high.

articles.title: No more standard blankets in Rajdhani First AC: Indian Railways brings a major change
articles.summary: Indian Railways replaces standard blankets with premium floral comforters in Howrah-New Delhi Rajdhani First AC. Here's what passengers should know about hygiene.

articles.title: Now, RCF-made Vande Bharat Express completes 180 kmph speed trial successfully
articles.summary: RCF Kapurthala has successfully tested a new 16-coach Vande Bharat Express train set at high speeds. The testing occurred at 180 kilometers per hour on the Mathura–Nagda section of railway. This development is part of Indian Railways' expansion of advanced trains since 2019.

articles.title: India rebuilding ties with China? Here’s what Piyush Goyal said
articles.summary: India is working to strengthen its relations with China, emphasizing the need for fair trade agreements and consistent engagement. The trade deficit with China has widened, raising concerns for India's economic outlook.

articles.title: Working remotely from abroad without approval? This trader's Singapore trip cost him his job
articles.summary: He had sought permission to work from Singapore for a year, but the company rejected the request. He later obtained approval to work from home for three months, citing an eye injury.

articles.summary: In 2022, the woman applied for 130 shares in an IPO. However, the bank recorded her application for just 65 shares, which she claimed resulted in a loss of Rs 42,142. She also accused the bank of causing her physical and mental harassment.

articles.title: Wholesale inflation rises to 11.39% in September from August's 9.9% on higher fuel, food prices
articles.summary: The Wholesale Price Index (WPI), with 2022-23 as the base year, rose to 112.5 in September from 110.8 in August. Wholesale inflation stood at 9.78% in July, as per the final estimates.
